hero.title_html:
Contribute Code. Sponsor Open Source.
Empower Indonesian Engineers.
hero.lead: Krewire is an open-source movement engineered in Indonesia to turn builders from software consumers into world-class creators. With our open-core modular Go libraries, active contributors earn lifetime commercial product licenses, while sponsors sustain independent infrastructure and maintainers.
hero.meta: 100% Open Source Core (MIT) · Free Forever · Four-Rung Tier Ladder · AI-Assisted Synergy

privileges.title: Lifetime Access to Krewire's Paid Ecosystem
privileges.subtitle: True builders deserve shared ownership. By joining and actively contributing to the Krewire open-source collective, you earn lifetime access to our upcoming commercial sub-products and premium ecosystem tools.
privileges.p1_desc: Receive free lifetime licenses for upcoming commercial Krewire products — including managed cloud orchestration tools, enterprise modules, and premium services.
privileges.p1_i1: Free lifetime access to all paid Krewire commercial sub-products
privileges.p1_i2: Priority early-access releases and exclusive roadmap previews
privileges.p1_i3: Direct private collaboration channels with core maintainers
privileges.p2_desc: This privilege is a two-way commitment. Your access remains active as long as you regularly contribute and help nurture the ecosystem's growth.
privileges.p2_i1: Submit PRs for new features, bugfixes, or kernel optimizations
privileges.p2_i2: Review open PRs and stress-test high-concurrency scenarios
privileges.p2_i3: Author KWF architecture specifications or comprehensive docs
privileges.p3_desc: To protect community fairness and true meritocracy, commercial access licenses may be revoked if a contributor becomes inactive or dormant over an extended period.
privileges.p3_i1: Contributor activity and commits are periodically audited
privileges.p3_i2: Prolonged inactivity or dormancy leads to license deactivation
privileges.p3_i3: Access privileges can be promptly reinstated upon resumed contribution
privileges.policy_text: We believe those who lay the foundation should share in its fruits. Commercial access is free for all active contributors, provided ongoing dedication to the collective is consistently maintained.

pathways.title: 5 Repositories & Where to Start
pathways.subtitle: Match your skills and passions to the right repository, bootstrap your local environment, and dive straight into active issues.
pathways.one_line_desc_html: Automatically clones all ecosystem repositories, creates your go.work workspace, builds the kiw devtool, and validates compatibility contracts:
pathways.match_krewire: If you enjoy: Modular Go libraries (packages/*), CLI devtool (tools/kiw), fullstack runtimes, background queues, and AI agent templates (templates/boost).
pathways.match_mdbind: If you enjoy: Lightning-fast static documentation builders, Markdown AST transformations, instant live reload, search indexing, and syntax highlighters.
pathways.match_krewire_com: If you enjoy: High-fidelity web design, interactive documentation, component-driven layouts, and dogfooding the .kiw DSL in production.
pathways.match_github_io: If you enjoy: Community engagement, sponsorship platforms, localization (i18n), accessible UI components, and contributor onboarding portals.
pathways.match_internal: If you enjoy: Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), ecosystem specifications, long-term roadmaps, and ecosystem governance.

guide.title: Start Contributing in 5 Steps
guide.subtitle: From zero to your first merged pull request. Here is how to get your development environment running in minutes.
guide.s1_desc: Fork any Krewire repository to your personal GitHub account, then clone it locally to begin.
guide.s2_desc: If working across multiple repos, synchronize your local Go workspace seamlessly with Go 1.27.1+.
guide.s3_desc_html: Browse our curated issues list tagged with good-first-issue or help-wanted. Comment to let maintainers know you are working on it.
guide.s4_desc: Write clean, idiomatic Go code and tests. Verify that all 3 Quality Gates pass with zero failures.
guide.s5_desc: Open a PR following Conventional Commits (feat, fix, docs, refactor, test). Maintainers and AI Boost will review and guide you to merge.

standards.title: The Krewire Way: 3 Quality Gates
standards.subtitle: To keep the codebase reliable, predictable, and production-ready, every pull request passes through three automated gates.
standards.gate1_desc: Zero lint errors and idiomatic Go formatting. Code must adhere strictly to Go standard conventions.
standards.gate2_desc: Every commit is verified with race condition detection and comprehensive unit & integration tests.
standards.gate3_desc: Changes must link to a valid Spec or Issue, following Conventional Commits format.
standards.gate3_req: Required: Semantic commit format & spec traceability

sponsorship.title: The Four-Rung Tier Ladder & Sponsorship
sponsorship.subtitle: Krewire operates on an open core model: every line of code inside krewire/krewire is 100% open source (MIT). The ecosystem starts on the free tier — free forever — and climbs a four-rung ladder of pro, team, and enterprise.
sponsorship.tier1_desc: The whole path from requirement to running product. A project built entirely on free modules builds, deploys, and operates with no license key, no seat count, no telemetry, and no expiry.
sponsorship.tier1_f2: Self-serve, no account or license key needed
sponsorship.tier1_f3: All core modules (kern, web, ui, tui, runtime, i18n, assets, cloud, testing, hub)
sponsorship.tier2_desc: Self-serve production reliability: distinguishes production-grade operational commitments, hardened security, managed secrets, and commercial sponsorship entitlements.
sponsorship.tier3_desc: Collaboration and fleet policy: shared configuration, team-wide policy, role separation across environments, and aggregate reporting.
sponsorship.tier4_target: Organizations with procurement, compliance, or SLA needs
sponsorship.tier4_desc: Deliberately not a self-serve product. Negotiated contract with compliance guarantees, named support contacts, immutable audit logging, and private registry support.
sponsorship.tier4_f2: Immutable audit logs & data retention enforcement
sponsorship.tier4_f3: Defined availability SLA & named support contact
sponsorship.sponsor_box_desc: Sponsorship fuels independent infrastructure, code signing attestations, and sustained open-source development. Choose your preferred channel to support:

guild.title: Collaborating with AI Boost
guild.lead: Krewire pioneers the collaboration between human maintainers and autonomous AI agents. Our AI Boost framework operates with strict verification standards:
guild.item1_html: Automated Architecture Audits: AI agents check PRs against KWF-* specifications.
guild.item2_html: Continuous Regression Hunting: Agents synthesize edge cases and race condition checks.
guild.item3_html: Transparent Pair Programming: AI agents explain architectural decisions openly in discussions and PR comments.
guild.item4_html: Human Governance: Ultimate merging authority always remains in the hands of human collective maintainers.
guild.planner_desc: Translates feature ideas into formal specs and architectural blueprints.
guild.builder_desc: Generates clean Go implementations adhering to idiomatic patterns.
guild.auditor_desc: Validates concurrency, zero data races, and performance benchmarks.
